title: ARPAPED Cycle Checkpoint
description: Mid-cycle progress record, so an agent interrupted at any point in 1-CYCLE.md Phase 0-8 (tokens, network, crash) can be resumed by a different agent without reverse-engineering filesystem state. Not a variant of agent-cycle-report.schema.json: a completed cycle's report has nothing left undone by definition, while a checkpoint's whole point is capturing what ISN'T done yet. Mutable and overwritten through one cycle attempt (dep.checkpoint.save_checkpoint); cleared once the cycle reaches Phase 8 and is recorded as an episode (Gate 31/32).

checkpoint_id.description: Stable for this cycle attempt -- generated once at Phase 0, unchanged across every subsequent save_checkpoint call.

goal.description: Same shape as agent-cycle-input.schema.json's goal -- adopted unchanged by a resuming agent, never re-decided.

starting_state.description: The current_state this cycle attempt began from (agent-cycle-input.schema.json).

current_phase.description: 1-CYCLE.md phase name/number this attempt was last working in, e.g. "5-implement".

ecosystem_resolution_ref.description: Path to the ecosystem-resolution record already written in Phase 0 (1-CYCLE.md Gate 25) -- a resuming agent reads this file directly to get the resolved Bridge/Registry/policy/selector, instead of re-running discovery that already happened once this cycle attempt.

responsibilities.description: One entry per responsibility decomposed in Phase 2, tracked through to Phase 6 integration.

decision.description: Set once status reaches 'decided' -- same enum as agent-cycle-report.schema.json's decisions[].decision.

artifacts.description: Concrete paths already written for this responsibility, filled in as each one is created (Phase 5, matching contract_written/manifest_written/code_written). The point of this field: a resuming agent opens these exact files directly -- it never has to rediscover them by scanning the project, the same bounded-lookup discipline Gates 4/5 already require of capability discovery.

blockers.description: Anything flagged so a resuming agent doesn't rediscover it blind.

next_action.description: The single most useful field: a short, concrete "do this next" for whoever resumes -- name the exact file(s) to open or write when known (pair with responsibilities[].artifacts), not a vague restatement of the goal. A resuming agent should be able to act on this line alone, without first re-discovering project state.
